objective: Expose the fail-closed Scientific Validation Gate through the API and Workbench.

baseline.description: Historical cycle record predates the current cumulative-lifecycle schema; the original baseline revision was not captured in the record.

reliability.reason: Historical record did not preserve a before/after reliability measurement.

coverage.reason: Historical record did not preserve a before/after coverage measurement.

scientific_validity.reason: This process change exposes validation evidence but does not itself constitute external scientific benchmark evidence.

evidence: Versioned /v1/scientific-validation endpoint evaluates the existing fail-closed gate.
Workbench has a dedicated Scientific Validation view.
Dashboard reports benchmark blockers and source-probe provenance separately.

findings: Release-blocking scientific evidence should be visible as a first-class product surface.
Missing scientific evidence must remain distinct from successful validation.
